Limits blur updates while an icon or multi-icon folder flies back to the desktop. Turn off to use the global blur FPS setting. The icon motion keeps the launcher’s native frame rate. Outside developer mode the 30 FPS limit applies.

Processes dock effects in the lower screen region instead of a full-screen buffer, with padding for motion and blur. Compare app closing smoothness; turn off if the dock clips during animation. Developer mode only.

Checks the system wallpaper ID on app return and reuses the processed static background. Wallpaper and processing settings changes still invalidate the cache. Not applied to live wallpapers or system wallpaper effects. Developer mode only.

Refreshes the dock plate and the icon blur only when something actually changed, and lands deferred blur samples on the next frame instead of a timer. Turn off to compare with the previous per-frame behaviour. Outside developer mode this stays on.
Blurs miniature icon backgrounds in folders.
Glass icons for the ColorOS launcher
A different icon style is selected. CherryPick currently supports only Flux icons. Select Flux in the system icon settings for correct appearance and animations.
Higher texture resolution reduces pixelation. Higher values use more GPU memory.
Boosts the wallpaper colors beneath the blur while keeping dark areas dark. Reduces color suppression from tinting.
Off: same as icons. On: independent folder settings.

Limits small icons in 1×1 folders and tiny previews in large folders to 30 FPS. Blur stays enabled; refraction is disabled for these miniatures. Large icons follow the global blur limit; limits below 30 FPS also apply to miniatures.
For icons that are a full picture without a single-colour plate (games, photos, gradients): the picture is recoloured into the palette tones and the glass shows through it. Works in developer mode.

Standard Material 3 layout for this settings app: top app bar, list rows with switches and supporting text, reset with confirmation. Changes only this screen; the classic interface stays the default. Active while developer mode is on; if the app crashes with it, it switches itself off.
Settings of this group will return to their default values.
Force icon blur updates at and beyond the screen edges during motion.
Limits color levels at the selected processing stage. 24 bits preserves full color; 8 bits gives strong color bands (RGB 3:3:2).
Order: blur → refraction → plate and shading → logo and contour. Above blur and below refraction refer to the same stage.
An experimental approximation: reduced contrast and a broad luminous veil on the glass. Blur radius works as usual, including 0. Logo and contour are preserved. Independent of color depth.
Off: original photo colors. On: match icon color.
On: GPU. Off: CPU. Applies to blur, refraction and material effects. Developer mode off uses GPU.
Save your settings to a JSON file to share them. Import replaces module settings; language and device status stay on this device.

Once per boot, after the first unlock within 15 minutes of a reboot, while the module is enabled. Ordinary unlocks never restart the launcher; if the system delays the boot event past that window, the restart is skipped.
Restarting the launcher after unlock for CherryPick Icons.

Save appearance for each wallpaper and restore it when that wallpaper returns. New wallpapers keep the current look. Layout, app and developer settings stay separate.

The system picker controls available themes and wallpaper sources. Private theme collections cannot be read through a standard Android API. Live wallpapers use a profile for their current installation; choosing a different video in the same service cannot safely identify the old video.
Capture launcher layers behind a dragged item. This can change its blur when lifted. Off by default: the item keeps the wallpaper and parent material used at rest.
Appearance copied to the current wallpaper.
No module settings have been saved for this theme yet.
Could not open this system theme.
The saved system theme catalogue is unavailable on this firmware or root access was denied.
Browse your saved themes. The checkmark opens the selected theme in the system editor; its Apply button preserves the full system theme.
Saved system themes are not exposed on this firmware. Showing the current wallpaper and installed live wallpaper services; their system preview handles application.
Keeps the blur snapshot for the entire open and close animation. Live blur fades in after the icon returns.
Intensifies bright colors already spread by the blur and deepens shadows. Requires iOS haze. No additional texture samples or blur passes; at radius 0 there is no broad halo. Off by default.
Smooths only the predictive offset while swiping. Uses the selected blur FPS; no separate 120 Hz update loop. Off by default.
0 keeps the native position. Negative moves up, positive moves down. Each control moves only its own element.
Tap the grid, page dots or dock in the diagram, then move the slider below. The named buttons select the same elements.
Choose color, frosted glass or liquid glass.

Recolored icons and widgets, without glass. Folder and dock glass can be enabled separately.
Uses the appearance mode and colors selected for icons.
Choose blur, refraction and tint for all folders and multi-folders. Icons keep their own settings.
